# Real redirect chains captured 2026-09-01 with:
#   curl -sIL --max-time 10 <url>
# Each block: the requested URL, every Location hop, and the landed URL.
# These are the trust surfaces Engine A probes: a status page that redirects
# to a different registrable domain is common, not hypothetical.

REQUESTED https://status.github.com
  HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
  Location: https://www.githubstatus.com/
  HTTP/1.1 200 OK
LANDED https://www.githubstatus.com/

REQUESTED https://status.anthropic.com
  HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
  Location: https://status.claude.com/
  HTTP/1.1 200 OK
LANDED https://status.claude.com/

REQUESTED https://status.notion.so
  HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
  Location: https://www.notion-status.com/
  HTTP/1.1 200 OK
LANDED https://www.notion-status.com/

REQUESTED https://status.shopify.com
  HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
  Location: https://www.shopifystatus.com/
  HTTP/1.1 200 OK
LANDED https://www.shopifystatus.com/
